<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/api/upload_code_list_file"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Stream an uploaded file to the store's staging and start a background job
that parses the whole file into a staged version. The job's ``staged``
carries the detected version, the code and active-code counts, the first 20
codes, and the numbers of codes added and removed against the version in use
(Requirement 13.2); for a SNOMED CT RF2 release also ``language`` (the
language reference set the names come from) and ``languages`` (every set
found, with its id, name where known, and count of preferred rows). The
caller polls ``list_code_lists`` (its ``jobs`` and each list's ``job``) for
it.

A file larger than 2 GiB is refused with 413 ``large_unconfirmed`` unless
``confirm_large`` is set; code list releases are smaller, so it is probably
the wrong file. Before the body is received, the grid checks the disks the
upload passes through have room for it, else 507 ``no_space``; a chunked
body, which gives no length, is checked once it is received. Refused on
an HA standby (Requirement 19.3). The staged version is not in use until
``import_code_list`` confirms it.
